title: From a Baby Photo With Messi to $45 Million
description:
Lionel Messi once gave him a bath. He was just a baby. In 2026 he beat him in a World Cup final.

Sources:
- Wikipedia: Lamine Yamal: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lamine_Yamal

From Wikipedia (Lamine Yamal): born 13 July 2007; as a baby he was in a 2007 UNICEF charity photo shoot with Barcelona in which a 20-year-old Lionel Messi bathed him; he started playing at age four at local club La Torreta; youngest player to represent Spain, at 16; on 27 May 2025 he agreed a contract to June 2031, which The Athletic reported could reach $45.3 million a year including bonuses; he won the 2026 World Cup with Spain, in a final against Messi's Argentina. Not financial advice.

#shorts #lamineyamal #soccer #howtheymakemoney
loop: So next time someone shows your baby photos, remember:
cta: Yamal or Messi? Comment your pick.

scenes.narration: Lionel Messi once gave him a bath. He was just a baby.
19 years later, they met in a World Cup final. Then he won it.
He only started at four, at a tiny local club.
Then at 16, Spain's youngest player ever.
Still a teenager, he signed to 2031. Reportedly up to 45.3 million dollars a year.
